text_block_list.text:
Though health issues prevented her from 
participating fully before, this year 
would be different. Mejiro Ardan's 
fighting spirit was soaring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for their autumn goals, a heated 
summer training camp was about to 
begin...!
